comparator.name: Bachelor Mechanical Engineering
comparator.sourceNotes: The current adopted 2026–2027 Mechanical Engineering/Marine Technology OER Mechanical Engineering curriculum table (PDF p.25) was freshly retrieved and visually inspected on 8 October 2026. It is the authoritative source for all 25 stored components, which remain unchanged and total 180 EC; the public programme page and curriculum API provide supporting programme context rather than a live complete course table. Year one comprises ten 6-EC units, including four mechanical-engineering design projects. Year two comprises ten 6-EC units, including four formally categorized projects: Project Advanced Engineering Design, Process Engineering and Thermodynamics, Robotics Project and Materials Science Project. Process Engineering and Thermodynamics is already counted within the existing 180 and is not an added fifth or duplicate unit. Year three preserves a genuine approved 30-EC minor and requires Systems and Control Engineering 6, Integrated Mechanical Systems 6, Engineer and Society 4 and Bachelor Final Project 14. Mathematics/mechanics subparts remain within their parent units. No named graduation route requires selection. The historical UCR assessment date and course evidence are preserved; this correction does not repeat or revalidate that judgment.

programmes.label: Bachelor Mechanical Engineering at Delft University of Technology

exception.reason: TU Delft Mechanical Engineering is an integrated engineering sequence in statics, mechanics of materials, dynamics, thermodynamics, advanced mechanics, materials science, fluid flow and heat transfer, process engineering, signals, systems and control, robotics and integrated mechanical systems. Four consecutive first-year design projects and four further second-year engineering projects culminate in a 14-EC mechanical-engineering final project. UCR offers useful mathematics, programming, product-design and sustainability courses, but it does not offer the mechanical-science core, engineering laboratory and workshop progression, or cumulative mechanical design and research sequence on which the degree depends. A 24-course response would be an applied mathematics, computing and sustainable-design programme, not Mechanical Engineering.

exception.ucrCourseEvidence: Reviewed all 151 current enriched UCR workbook rows, including descriptions, outline-derived profiles, topics, methods, prerequisites and planned semesters. DISGATE102 Mathematical Methods, DISMATH211 Linear Algebra, DISMATH214 Advanced Calculus, DISMATH213 Computational & Numerical Methods, DISMATH312 Linear Systems and DISMATH314 Probability & Statistics provide relevant quantitative tools, while DISGATE101 Introduction to Programming adds computing. BENENTR111 Consumer Product Design covers customer needs, fabrication planning, prototyping and sustainability; ENSSUST112 Life Cycle Analysis & Circular Economy and ENSSUST311 Renewable System Design address environmental impact and sustainable energy-system assessment. The workbook nevertheless contains no statics or mechanics-of-materials course; no thermodynamics, fluid-mechanics or heat-transfer sequence; no engineering materials, manufacturing-process, elasticity, tribology, mechanical dynamics, robotics, mechatronics or finite-element course; and no mechanical-engineering laboratory, workshop, integrated design-project or bachelor-research sequence. The adjacent courses cannot supply a coherent 23-course non-PPD mechanical-engineering pathway.
